text: I can't say na i'm not okay with that, so yuh I said na its fine.
I don't know how to respond dun sorry...
Just like what I said diba I can't sometimes ano what I feel kasi takot ako on how people will react so here..

Don't be scared or sorry, Gel. It's much easier for me to know what's bothering you than for you to hide it and be scared of my reaction. I know about your traumas and everything you've been through, which is why it's completely okay if you ask me or tell me things directly. That's also why I always ask questions, because sometimes my actions might trigger something in you without me realizing it. Please always communicate with me. I want to know you better, and I don't want you to keep overthinking or feel trapped by your traumas. Free yourself by facing your fears because I will always be here for you, Gel. I love you so much, and loving you means understanding and accepting the real you, flaws, fears, traumas, and all.

                                              -J
